courses.overview: 從模組級 MPPT、功率解耦與屋頂熱可靠度延伸至相近領域；相似物理不代表同一設備規格或驗收程序。
courses.overviewEn: Extend module-level mppt, power decoupling and rooftop thermal reliability to neighboring domains; shared physics does not imply identical equipment requirements or acceptance procedures.

related.title: 串列型太陽能逆變器
related.why: 逆變與 MPPT 物理一致
related.transfer: 逆變與 MPPT 物理一致
related.difference: 單相雙頻脈動及分散散熱條件不同
related.differenceEn: Single-phase ripple and distributed cooling differ
practice: 以「模組級控制」為起點，畫出本課與「串列型太陽能逆變器」可共用及須重畫的系統邊界。
針對「單相雙頻脈動及分散散熱條件不同」各選一項能區分兩課的量測。
將本課算例移植到新情境：保留方程依據，重新指定單位、材料或拓撲，並標示無法沿用的數值。
practiceEn: Start from module-level control and mark shared/redefined boundaries with string solar inverters.
For the difference "Single-phase ripple and distributed cooling differ", choose discriminating measurements for both courses.
Transfer the worked example: retain justified equations, respecify units, materials or topology and identify values that cannot transfer.
